description: At 2:15 in the morning, a voice calls your name from the black pine woods outside your cabin.

It sounds identical to your sister, begging you to unlock the front door. But she is hours away in the city. A skinwalker only needs to hear your voice once to steal it forever. Using dual acoustic voice boxes like a lyrebird, it reproduces human timbre with mechanical perfection. It cannot understand words; it only replays recorded sound waves. And it has one fatal weakness.
A Scroll Kaos paper-cutout horror animation. Watch until the very end.
credit_long: Inspired by American folklore and the vocal acoustics of the forest mimic. This is a non-graphic retelling in our own words, with original artwork. Our creature design and anatomical diagrams are original drawings; no copyrighted character was copied.
